capabilities: Sync a designated IMAP folder into Markdown notes
Store the original .eml next to each note
Send mail over SMTP, including iMIP calendar invitations
List inbox messages and move them to the vault folder
Re-render notes, relink threads and extract attachments
extras: Sync, sending and the inbox tab are desktop only; mobile can only read notes a desktop already synchronised. No OAuth flow, so providers requiring it (Gmail with 2FA, Microsoft 365) are unsupported. The optional pseudonymizer plugin is not published yet, so the Required setting writes no new mail until it exists.
problem: Mail worth keeping sits in a mail client while the notes derived from it belong in the vault, with no durable link between the two.

relations.evidence: the plugin delivers iMIP calendar invitations on behalf of the sister plugin calendar-notes
once TaskNotes is installed — Create task
Mailstone can hand every new mail to a separate plugin, pseudonymizer, before the note is written

requires.name: IMAP/SMTP mail account with an app password

summary: Turns one designated IMAP folder into Markdown notes with the original .eml kept beside them, and sends mail over SMTP.
